name: agent-hub
description: A local hub where coding agents (Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini) run, collaborate and can be controlled from any paired device on your LAN.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agent-hub/web && npm run build -w @agent-hub/hub && npm run build -w @agent-hub/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/hub --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit && tsc -p packages/desktop --noEmit
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run dist -w @agent-hub/desktop
